sql: select pm.match_id, pm.hero_id, pm.gold_t, (select min((e->>'time')::int) from unnest(pm.purchase_log) e where e->>'key' = 'bfury') as purchase_time from player_matches pm join match_patch mp using(match_id) where mp.patch = '7.41' and pm.gold_t is not null and pm.hero_id = 1 order by pm.match_id desc limit 2000
